messages:
alex: I grabbed a perfetto trace from the 2pm staging soak. Seeing a repeated ~90ms idle window between gateway.finish and runtime.dispatch for ~7% of requests. Link: https://perfetto.pro/trace/def456

sam: can you paste the waterfall snippet? quick look: is it syscall wakeups or scheduling gaps?

alex: here's the filtered view I used:
```
filter: span.name contains "gateway" or "runtime"
note: gap occurs after gateway.finish and before runtime.dispatch
```
The gap aligns with a gateway batching flush and runtime.wait_for_batch logs.

maria: short hypotheses: (A) bursty KV misses cause gateway to flush unevenly -> runtime waits for batch; (B) runtime kernel selection delays when awaiting a particular batch size for the preferred kernel (quantized vs fp16). Both could yield ~60-120ms consistent gaps.

devon: nvprof from a related run showed tiny kernel preempts (10-30ms) that co-occur. Might be kernel swap overhead when switching execution paths mid-stream.

alex: pasted excerpt from app logs (redacted):
```
[2026-02-21T14:05:12Z] gateway: kv_fetch start key=ctx:xyz
[2026-02-21T14:05:12Z] gateway: kv_fetch miss -> escalate to runtime
[2026-02-21T14:05:12Z] gateway: batching flush triggered (count=28 -> threshold=32)
[2026-02-21T14:05:12Z] gateway: span.finish
[2026-02-21T14:05:12Z] runtime: wait_for_batch -> 92ms
[2026-02-21T14:05:12Z] runtime: kernel_select -> fallback_fp16
```
That wait_for_batch is the idle period in perfetto.

perf-bot: nsys summary: gpu_util=22%, kernel_switches=36, cpu_idle_windows=11, syscall_blocks=3 (short).

sam: test plan: (1) bump gateway flush threshold to 64 and rerun perfetto+nsys with --record-syscalls, (2) add a short metric runtime.batch_wait_ms to console dashboards, (3) force runtime to prefer quantized kernels in a canary to see effect.

maria: if quantized path removes the gap, kernel selection heuristics need a threshold tweak or fallback timeout. If gap persists even with no KV misses, look at OS scheduling/epoll wake latency.

devon: I'll spin a canary toggling the kernel hint and run nvprof/nsys snapshots. I'll also capture kernel timeline to see if a kernel-context switch lines up with the idle window.

alex: queued a staging run (tag=trace-stitch-kvburst) with flush=64. Will attach full perfetto + nsys when done. For now saved the trace to /incidents/perf/trace-stitch-kvburst.

sam: ack. quick note: include the gateway->runtime RPC payload sizes in the capture. if batching alignment is influenced by variable payloads (ctx lengths) that could shift batch thresholds.

alex: good call — adding payload-size histogram. also adding a small probe to log kv_miss_rate per-second so we can correlate gaps with miss storms.

maria: action items recap: [alex] rerun and attach traces; [devon] canary quantized vs fp16; [sam] add RPC payload histogram to trace; [perf-bot] keep an eye on kernel_switches metric in the next soak.

devon: noted. if gap goes away with quantized path, I'll sketch a quick tuning PR: prefer quantized for batches < 48 or timeout->force.

sam: sounds good. if anyone sees the same 90ms gap on runs with negligible kv misses, post here — then it's likely queueing/scheduler related rather than batching.

alex: thanks team. will post results in this thread once the soak completes.
